curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover route marker shapes, bicycle and pedestrian crossing signs, the three-foot passing rule, the full-lane sign, and the slow-moving vehicle triangle.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per sign or rule; contrast card for passing distance versus lane position.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on special signs and bicycle rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach who may use disabled spaces, the van-access crosshatch, when a placard holder must be present, and the penalties for misuse.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each rule; contrast cards for the crosshatch and for borrowed versus missing placards.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on disabled parking scenarios.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what pavement markings do, then broken, solid and mixed yellow lines and the two exceptions to solid yellow.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per line type; contrast cards for the mixed pair and the solid yellow exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether passing is allowed.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach white lines, the yellow versus white rule, green bike paint, sharrows, crosswalk duties and conflict zones.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each marking; contrast card for line colors.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on markings and crosswalk rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Start with keeping right and in one lane, unmarked roads, then restricted, bike, transit and HOV lanes.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each lane type; contrast card for the white diamond.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who may use a lane.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach center turn lane use, reversible lanes and their markings, and the diverging diamond interchange.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each lane; contrast card for reversible versus center turn lanes.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach direction of travel, yielding to large vehicles, yielding to circulating traffic, crosswalks and signaling.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each roundabout rule; contrast card for the yield layers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on roundabout right of way.
